answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral, so equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs aggregate penalties proportional to k² rather than k. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds the loss across the swarm, imposing an exponential multiplier on capital at risk. A delta in evidence thresholds, velvet-gloved coordination, or a rising tide of messages cannot remove the common exposure: identities controlled together remain economically linked.
